note: Private RV park tucked behind a gas station at I-24 exit 31 in Grand Rivers, between Kentucky Lake and Lake Barkley; beside the Livingston County trail system and a bike pump track. Concrete pads. No bathhouse, so self-contained RVs only (no tents). Sites 23-26 suit rigs of 34 ft or less; 15-21 are set aside for 36-45 ft rigs. Takes longer stays, including work crews, as well as overnight travelers. --Claude
summary: Private, 31 FHU 30/50A concrete sites (+ camphost), Newbook engine $47 nightly (stored low $37.71 was the WEEKLY per-night rate), no bathhouse, laundry/wifi/dump, max 45 ft. Google 4.3/166. Passes price; occupancy high (one site free online on Dec weeknights) with a work-crew/long-stay pitch - flagged for the long-stay read.

LONG-STAY (report, not a drop as read): the operator courts both 'overnight travelers and those looking for longer-term options' and 'construction workers needing a place to settle for a while'; weekly rates on the engine; no monthly/seasonal rate posted. The site map's 'Overnight Site Details' names sites 15-26 (12 of 31 rentable sites); the engine offered ONE site (a back-in) on each of two sampled December 2026 weeknights and no pull-through, and imagery shows the loops packed with RVs. Nightly share therefore looks like ~12 of 31 (about 40%) at most; the five tests: (1) nightly rate posted yes, (2) nightly booking engine yes, (3) no lot sales seen, (4) well over 1 in 10 sold nightly, (5) no residency wording. Kept with a 'takes longer stays, including work crews' line; AWH may want 'Mostly long-stay' instead.
